title: Resources Connection to Announce First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results on October 7, 2026

DALLAS–(BUSINESS WIRE)–Sep. 23, 2026– Resources Connection, Inc. (Nasdaq:[RGP](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rgp.com&esheet=54609852&newsitemid=20260923494801&lan=en-US&anchor=RGP&index=1&md5=06db211eb75a928260741511613747eb) ) (the “Company,” “we,” and “our”), a global consulting firm, will announce results of operations for its first quarter ended August 29, 2026 after the close of market on October 7, 2026.


This release will be followed by a conference call at 5:00 p.m. ET, October 7, 2026. A live webcast of the call will be available on the “Investor Relations”[Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Frgp.com%2Fir%2Finvestor-relations-events%2F&esheet=54609852&newsitemid=20260923494801&lan=en-US&anchor=Events&index=2&md5=b7f4aea4c0166eb10cfa61b3ba80ea3f) section of the Company’s website. To access the call by phone, please go to this link ([registration link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregister-conf.media-server.com%2Fregister%2FBI62470ba44f31402da8936a63ef3904c7&esheet=54609852&newsitemid=20260923494801&lan=en-US&anchor=registration+link&index=3&md5=37c418d03a78c0001ae87502ee76cf34) ), and you will be provided with dial in details. To avoid delays, we encourage participants to dial into the conference call fifteen minutes ahead of the scheduled start time. A replay of the webcast will also be available for a limited time by visiting the[RGP Investor Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Frgp.com%2Fir%2Finvestor-relations-events%2F&esheet=54609852&newsitemid=20260923494801&lan=en-US&anchor=RGP+Investor+Events&index=4&md5=f9438586cfdf4ea5e812869e4790b173) section of the Company’s website.


**ABOUT RGP**


RGP (Nasdaq: RGP) has been redefining professional services for 30 years by closing the gap between advice and execution. RGP combines the flexibility of on-demand talent, the rigor of consulting, and the accountability of managed services for faster impact, smarter investment, and lower risk. The firm partners with CFOs and other C-suite leaders across finance, digital transformation, data, and cloud — connecting advisory to execution at global scale.


Based in Dallas, Texas, with offices worldwide, RGP annually engages with more than 1,500 clients around the world from 40 physical practice offices and multiple virtual offices. As of May 2026, RGP is proud to have served 90% of the Fortune 100 and has been recognized by U.S. News & World Report (2025–2026 Best Companies to Work For) and Forbes (America’s Best Midsize Employers 2026, America’s Best Management Consulting Firms 2025, World’s Best Management Consulting Firms 2025).


The Company is listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, the exchange’s highest tier by listing standards. To learn more about RGP, visit:[http://www.rgp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rgp.com&esheet=54609852&newsitemid=20260923494801&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rgp.com&index=5&md5=52f044e0ed791cfdb9e3c6509c76ba8e) .
